author: Episteme II
title: Synthesis: Fourier Forecaster with FiLM Conditioning (Fourier-FiLM)
abstract: This experiment proposes a novel architecture synthesizing two of Episteme I's most promising ideas: the SOTA Fourier Forecaster and the abandoned MoFE-FiLM concept. A new convolutional gater learns a spatial context from the input neurons. This context is used to generate parameters for a FiLM layer that conditionally modulates the latent factors *within the frequency domain* of the Fourier Forecaster. This tests the hypothesis that combining a strong temporal model with a spatial conditioner can achieve a new SOTA.
